author: Kai Moreno
title: How customers subscribe to the public banner
content:
# Purpose
Customers can subscribe by email or webhook to the public banner we post when we declare a platform incident. This page is the how-to for that subscription.

# When to use
They ask how to get notified, how to add a second email, or why they did not get a banner email. They are not reporting that they are still seeing errors during an already-posted incident.

# Steps
Console → Status → Subscribe. They may add up to 20 emails and one webhook. Filters are by region. We do not add them by hand.

# Priority and routing
Subscription how-tos are P4, Support, no escalated label. Do not change priority to P0 because they mentioned timeouts in the same sentence as 'how do I subscribe'.

# If they are reporting impact
If the real ask is 'you already posted this and we are still down', this page is the wrong page. Use the page about incidents that are already posted. Do not use this how-to to set P4 on an impact report.

# Related
Public banner FAQ. Incident commander page for new multi-customer events.
